               card = result
                    SpotifyState[key] = card
                else
                    warn("[YinYang Spotify] No se pudo crear la tarjeta: " .. tostring(result))
                end
            end
            if card and card.Parent then
                card.Visible = showTiles
                if showTiles then card.LayoutOrder = position end
            end
            return card
        end

        tile("_FavoritesTile", createFavoritesTile, 1)
        local mySongsTile = tile("_MySongsTile", createMySongsTile, 2)
        if showTiles then
            displayOrder = 3
            if mySongsTile then
                local countLabel = mySongsTile:FindFirstChild("MySongsCount")
                if countLabel then
                    local count = tostring(#SpotifyState.UserSongs)
                    countLabel.Text = GetText(count .. " canciones propias", count .. " personal songs")
                    countLabel:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", count .. " canciones propias")
                    countLabel:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", count .. " personal songs")
                end
            end
        end

        for _, index in ipairs(order) do
            local track = SpotifyState.Catalog[index]
            if track and not SpotifyState.HiddenRows[index] then
                local rowData = SpotifyState.RowButtons[index]
                if rowData and rowData.Row and rowData.Row.Parent then
                    rowData.Row.LayoutOrder = displayOrder
                    if not rowData.Row.Visible then rowData.Row.Visible = true end
                else
                    pcall(createSongRow, track, index, displayOrder)
                end
                displayOrder = displayOrder + 1
            end
        end
        updateSongListCanvas()
        updateSpotifyCanvas()
        task.defer(function()
            pcall(updateSongListCanvas)
            pcall(updateSpotifyCanvas)
        end)
    end

    local function updatePlayerFromTrack(track, index, statusText)
        if not track then
            return
        end

        local seed = tostring(track.Id or track.Name or index or "spotify")
        local hash = 0
        for i = 1, #seed do
            hash = (hash * 31 + string.byte(seed, i)) % 360
        end
        local fallbackColor = Color3.fromHSV(hash / 360, 0.52, 0.28)
        local resolvedCover = resolveTrackCoverImage(track)
        local hasCover = trim(resolvedCover or "") ~= ""

        NowPlayingBackdrop.Image = hasCover and resolvedCover or ""
        NowPlayingBackdrop.ImageTransparency = hasCover and 0.55 or 1
        NowPlayingBackdrop.BackgroundColor3 = hasCover and Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 10) or fallbackColor
        NowPlayingBackdrop.BackgroundTransparency = hasCover and 0.12 or 0.06
        NowPlayingShade.BackgroundTransparency = hasCover and 0.52 or 0.30
        AlbumArt.Image = hasCover and resolvedCover or ""
        AlbumArt.BackgroundColor3 = hasCover and Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) or fallbackColor
        AlbumFallback.Visible = not hasCover
        if Window._SpotifyAmbient then Window._SpotifyAmbient.SetCover(resolvedCover) end

        PlayerSongTitle.Text = track.Name
        PlayerSongArtist.Text = track.Artist
        PlayerMeta.Text = statusText or (SpotifyState.IsPlaying and "Reproducción activa" or "Reproducción lista")
        ProgressTimeRight.Text = track.Duration

        if index and SpotifyState.Catalog[index] then
            SpotifyState.SelectedIndex = index
        end

        refreshAllRows()
        refreshSpotifyFloatingPlayer()
        if SpotifyState.RefreshMiniPlayer then SpotifyState.RefreshMiniPlayer() end
    end

    local function destroyCurrentSound()
        if SpotifyState.SoundProgressConnection then
            pcall(function()
                SpotifyState.SoundProgressConnection:Disconnect()
            end)
            SpotifyState.SoundProgressConnection = nil
        end

        if SpotifyState.SoundEndedConnection then
            pcall(function()
                SpotifyState.SoundEndedConnection:Disconnect()
            end)
            SpotifyState.SoundEndedConnection = nil
        end

        if SpotifyState.CurrentSound then
            pcall(function()
                SpotifyState.CurrentSound:Stop()
            end)
            safeDestroy(SpotifyState.CurrentSound)
            SpotifyState.CurrentSound = nil
        end
    end

    local function syncPlaybackUI()
        if SpotifyState.CurrentSound then
            PlayPauseBtn.Image = SpotifyState.IsPlaying and asset(74873705394436) or asset(135609604299893)
        else
            PlayPauseBtn.Image = asset(135609604299893)
        end

        RepeatBtn.ImageColor3 = SpotifyState.IsRepeat and spotifyGreen or spotifyText
        LikeBtn.ImageColor3 = isLiked(SpotifyState.SelectedIndex) and spotifyGreen or spotifyText

        if isLiked(SpotifyState.SelectedIndex) then
            LikeBtn.Image = asset(116559368303288)
        else
            LikeBtn.Image = asset(116559368303288)
        end
        refreshSpotifyFloatingPlayer()
        if SpotifyState.RefreshMiniPlayer then SpotifyState.RefreshMiniPlayer() end
        if SpotifyState.RefreshBoombox then SpotifyState.RefreshBoombox() end
        if SpotifyState.OnPlaybackChanged then
            pcall(SpotifyState.OnPlaybackChanged)
        end
    end

    local function updateProgress(track, sound)
        local total = track and durationToSeconds(track.Duration) or 0
        if sound and sound.TimeLength and sound.TimeLength > 0 then
            total = math.max(total, math.floor(sound.TimeLength))
        end
        total = math.max(total, 1)

        local current = 0
        if sound and sound.TimePosition then
            current = math.floor(sound.TimePosition)
        end

        ProgressTimeLeft.Text = secondsToClock(current)
        ProgressTimeRight.Text = (track and track.IsUserSong and sound and sound.TimeLength > 0)
            and secondsToClock(sound.TimeLength)
            or (track and track.Duration or secondsToClock(total))
        ProgressFill.Size = UDim2.new(clamp(current / total, 0, 1), 0, 1, 0)
        refreshSpotifyFloatingPlayer()
        if SpotifyState.RefreshMiniPlayer then SpotifyState.RefreshMiniPlayer(current / total) end
        if SpotifyState.RefreshBoombox then SpotifyState.RefreshBoombox() end
    end

    local function ensureTrackCached(track)
        local cacheName = track.CacheName
        local audioExists = false
        local audioPath = cacheName

        if isfile then
            local okFile, resultFile = pcall(function()
                return isfile(audioPath)
            end)
            audioExists = okFile and resultFile == true
        end

        if not audioExists then
            if not writefile then
                return false, "writefile_unavailable"
            end

            local okDownload, data = pcall(function()
                return game:HttpGet(track.AudioURL, true)
            end)

            if not okDownload or type(data) ~= "string" or #data < 10 then
                return false, "download_failed"
            end

            local okWrite = pcall(function()
                writefile(audioPath, data)
            end)

            if not okWrite then
                return false, "cache_write_failed"
            end
        end

        local customAsset = audioPath
        if getcustomasset then
            local okAsset, resultAsset = pcall(function()
                return getcustomasset(audioPath)
            end)
            if okAsset and type(resultAsset) == "string" then
                customAsset = resultAsset
            end
        end

        return true, customAsset
    end

    local function ensureCoverCached(track)
        if not track.CoverURL or track.CoverURL == "" then
            return false, "no_cover_url"
        end

        local cacheName = track.CoverCacheName
        if not cacheName or cacheName == "" then
            return false, "no_cover_cache_name"
        end

        local coverPath = "YinYang_Cover_" .. cacheName
        local coverExists = false

        if isfile then
            local okFile, resultFile = pcall(function()
                return isfile(coverPath)
            end)
            coverExists = okFile and resultFile == true
        end

        if not coverExists then
            if not writefile then
                return false, "writefile_unavailable"
            end

            local okDownload, data = pcall(function()
                return game:HttpGet(track.CoverURL, true)
            end)

            if not okDownload or type(data) ~= "string" or #data < 10 then
                warn("[YinYang Spotify] Falló la descarga de portada (" .. tostring(track.CoverURL) .. "): " .. tostring(data))
                return false, "download_failed"
            end

            local okWrite = pcall(function()
                writefile(coverPath, data)
            end)

            if not okWrite then
                warn("[YinYang Spotify] Falló writefile para la portada: " .. coverPath)
                return false, "cache_write_failed"
            end
        end

        if not getcustomasset then
            warn("[YinYang Spotify] getcustomasset no está disponible en este ejecutor; no se puede mostrar la portada: " .. coverPath)
            return false, "getcustomasset_unavailable"
        end

        local okAsset, resultAsset = pcall(function()
            return getcustomasset(coverPath)
        end)

        if not (okAsset and type(resultAsset) == "string") then
            warn("[YinYang Spotify] getcustomasset falló para la portada (" .. coverPath .. "): " .. tostring(resultAsset))
            return false, "getcustomasset_failed"
        end

        return true, resultAsset
    end

    local CoverAssetResolvedCache = {}

    resolveTrackCoverImage = function(track)
        if not track then
            return ""
        end

        if track.CoverURL and track.CoverURL ~= "" then
            local cacheKey = (track.CoverCacheName and track.CoverCacheName ~= "") and track.CoverCacheName or track.CoverURL
            local cached = CoverAssetResolvedCache[cacheKey]
            if cached then
                return cached
            end

            local okCover, coverAssetOrErr = ensureCoverCached(track)
            if okCover then
                CoverAssetResolvedCache[cacheKey] = coverAssetOrErr
                return coverAssetOrErr
            end
        end

        return track.Cover or ""
    end

    local function playTrack(index)
        local track = SpotifyState.Catalog[index]
        if not track then
            return
        end

        SpotifyState.SelectedIndex = index
        SpotifyState.CurrentTrack = track
        SpotifyState.CurrentTrackSeconds = durationToSeconds(track.Duration)
        SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition = 0
        SpotifyState.IsPlaying = true

        destroyAllSpotifySounds()
        destroyCurrentSound()

        updatePlayerFromTrack(track, index, "Descargando y reproduciendo...")
        syncPlaybackUI()

        local okCache, cachedAssetOrErr = ensureTrackCached(track)
        local soundAsset = okCache and cachedAssetOrErr or track.AudioURL

        local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
        sound.Name = "YY_Spotify_CurrentSound"
        sound.SoundId = soundAsset
        sound.Volume = SpotifyState.PlaybackVolume
        sound.PlaybackSpeed = SpotifyState.PlaybackSpeed
        sound.Looped = SpotifyState.IsRepeat
        sound.Parent = workspace

        SpotifyState.CurrentSound = sound

        SpotifyState.SoundProgressConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if SpotifyState.CurrentSound == sound then
                updateProgress(track, sound)
            end
        end)

        SpotifyState.SoundEndedConnection = sound.Ended:Connect(function()
            if SpotifyState.CurrentSound ~= sound then
                return
            end

            if SpotifyState.IsRepeat then
                task.spawn(function()
                    pcall(function()
                        sound.TimePosition = 0
                        sound:Play()
                        SpotifyState.IsPlaying = true
                        syncPlaybackUI()
                    end)
                end)
                return
            end

            local nextIndex = index + 1
            if nextIndex > #SpotifyState.Catalog then
                nextIndex = 1
            end
            if SpotifyState.FavoriteNeighbor then
                nextIndex = SpotifyState.FavoriteNeighbor(index, 1) or nextIndex
            end
            playTrack(nextIndex)
        end)

        pcall(function()
            sound:Play()
        end)

        SpotifyState.IsPlaying = true
        updatePlayerFromTrack(track, index, GetText("Reproduciendo", "Playing"))
        syncPlaybackUI()
    end

    local function selectTrack(index)
        local track = SpotifyState.Catalog[index]
        if not track then
            return
        end

        SpotifyState.SelectedIndex = index
        SpotifyState.CurrentTrack = track
        SpotifyState.IsPlaying = SpotifyState.CurrentSound ~= nil and SpotifyState.IsPlaying or false
        updatePlayerFromTrack(track, index, "Seleccionada: " .. track.Name)
        syncPlaybackUI()
    end

    local function toggleTrackLike(index)
        SpotifyState.CurrentLiked[index] = not isLiked(index)
        saveSpotifyFavorite(index)
        renderSongRows()
        syncPlaybackUI()
    end

    local function bindRowTap(guiObject, callback)
        if not guiObject then
            return
        end

        pcall(function()
            guiObject.Active = true
            guiObject.Selectable = false
        end)

        local lastFire = 0
        local function fireOnce()
            local now = os.clock()
            if now - lastFire < 0.35 then
                return
            end
            lastFire = now

            local ok, err = pcall(callback)
            if not ok then
                warn("[YinYang Spotify] Row tap failed: " .. tostring(err))
            end
        end

        if guiObject:IsA("GuiButton") then
            track(guiObject.Activated:Connect(fireOnce))
            track(guiObject.MouseButton1Click:Connect(fireOnce))
            track(guiObject.TouchTap:Connect(fireOnce))
            return
        end

        local activeInput = nil
        local startPosition = nil
        local moved = false
        local threshold = 14

        track(guiObject.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                activeInput = input
                startPosition = input.Position
                moved = false
            end
        end))

        track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if activeInput and input == activeInput and startPosition then
                local delta = input.Position - startPosition
                if delta.Magnitude > threshold then
                    moved = true
                end
            end
        end))

        track(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if activeInput and input == activeInput then
                if not moved then
                    fireOnce()
                end
                activeInput = nil
                startPosition = nil
                moved = false
            end
        end))
    end

    local function applyPlaybackVolume(value)
        SpotifyState.PlaybackVolume = clamp(value, 0, 1)
        if SpotifyState.CurrentSound then pcall(function() SpotifyState.CurrentSound.Volume = SpotifyState.PlaybackVolume end) end
        refreshSpotifyPlaybackMenu(); refreshSpotifyFloatingPlayer()
    end
    local function applyPlaybackSpeed(value)
        SpotifyState.PlaybackSpeed = clamp(value, 0.50, 2)
        if SpotifyState.CurrentSound then pcall(function() SpotifyState.CurrentSound.PlaybackSpeed = SpotifyState.PlaybackSpeed end) end
        refreshSpotifyPlaybackMenu(); refreshSpotifyFloatingPlayer()
    end

        end
    end))

            task.defer(function() SpotifyState.BlockSwipe = false end)
        end
    end))

        corner(pill, 999)
        local knob = mk("Frame", {

            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 45,
        })
        corner(knob, 999)
        local entry = {Pill = pill, Knob = knob, Get = getter}
        PM.switches[#PM.switches + 1] = entry
        bindRowTap(hit, function()
            setter(not getter())
            refreshSpotifyPlaybackMenu()
        end)
        return entry
    end
    PM.paintSwitch = function(entry)
        local on = entry.Get() == true
        TweenService:Create(entry.Pill, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = on and spotifyGreen or Color3.fromRGB(77, 77, 77)}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(entry.Knob, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = on and UDim2.new(1, -19, 0.5, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, 0)}):Play()
    end

    PM.setRepeat = function(value)
        SpotifyState.IsRepeat = value == true
        if SpotifyState.CurrentSound then
            pcall(function() SpotifyState.CurrentSound.Looped = SpotifyState.IsRepeat end)
        end
        syncPlaybackUI()
    end

    PM.divider(7)

    PM.TimerBox = PM.section(8, 66)
    PM.label(PM.TimerBox, "Temporizador de apagado", 0)
    PM.TimerValue = PM.valueLabel(PM.TimerBox, 0)
    PM.TimerRow = mk("Frame", {
        Parent = PM.TimerBox,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 28),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        ZIndex = 43,
    })
    mk("UIGridLayout", {
        Parent = PM.TimerRow,
        CellSize = UDim2.new(1 / #PM.TIMERS, -5, 1, 0),
        CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 0),
        SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
    })
    PM.timerLeft = function()
        if not SpotifyState.SleepAt then return nil end
        return math.max(0, SpotifyState.SleepAt - os.clock())
    end
    for i, minutes in ipairs(PM.TIMERS) do
        local text = minutes == 0 and "No" or (minutes >= 60 and "1 h" or (tostring(minutes) .. "m"))
        local chip = PM.chip(PM.TimerRow, text)
        chip.LayoutOrder = i
        PM.timerChips[i] = {Button = chip, Value = minutes}
        bindRowTap(chip, function()
            SpotifyState.SleepMinutes = minutes
            SpotifyState.SleepAt = minutes > 0 and (os.clock() + minutes * 60) or nil
            refreshSpotifyPlaybackMenu()
        end)
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        while PM.Panel.Parent do
            local left = PM.timerLeft()
            if left then
                if left <= 0 then
                    SpotifyState.SleepAt = nil
                    SpotifyState.SleepMinutes = 0
                    if SpotifyState.CurrentSound and SpotifyState.IsPlaying then
                        pcall(function()
                            SpotifyState.IsPlaying = false
                            SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition = math.max(0, tonumber(SpotifyState.CurrentSound.TimePosition) or 0)
                            SpotifyState.CurrentSound:Pause()
                        end)
                        PlayerMeta.Text = GetText("Pausado por el temporizador", "Paused by sleep timer")
                        syncPlaybackUI()
                    end
                end
                if PM.Panel.Visible then refreshSpotifyPlaybackMenu() end
            end
            task.wait(1)
        end
    end)

    local FloatingPlayer = nil
    local FP = {mini = false, lastCover = nil, rotation = 0}
    local function previousTrack()
        if #SpotifyState.Catalog == 0 then return end
        local index = SpotifyState.SelectedIndex - 1
        if index < 1 then index = #SpotifyState.Catalog end
        if SpotifyState.FavoriteNeighbor then
            index = SpotifyState.FavoriteNeighbor(SpotifyState.SelectedIndex, -1) or index
        end
        playTrack(index)
    end
    local function nextTrack()
        if #SpotifyState.Catalog == 0 then return end
        local index = SpotifyState.SelectedIndex + 1
        if index > #SpotifyState.Catalog then index = 1 end
        if SpotifyState.FavoriteNeighbor then
            index = SpotifyState.FavoriteNeighbor(SpotifyState.SelectedIndex, 1) or index
        end
        playTrack(index)
    end
    local function togglePlayback()
        if SpotifyState.CurrentSound then
            if SpotifyState.IsPlaying then
                SpotifyState.IsPlaying = false
                pcall(function()
                    SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition = math.max(0, tonumber(SpotifyState.CurrentSound.TimePosition) or 0)
                    SpotifyState.CurrentSound:Pause()
                end)
                PlayerMeta.Text = GetText("Reproducción pausada", "Playback paused")
            else
                SpotifyState.IsPlaying = true
                pcall(function()
                    if SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition and SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition > 0 then SpotifyState.CurrentSound.TimePosition = SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition end
                    SpotifyState.CurrentSound:Play()
                end)
                PlayerMeta.Text = GetText("Reproducción activa", "Playback active")
            end
            syncPlaybackUI()
        elseif SpotifyState.Catalog[SpotifyState.SelectedIndex] then
            playTrack(SpotifyState.SelectedIndex)
        end
    end
    -- La cabecera comparte el sonido de Spotify y conserva el campo de IDs al detenerlo.
    do
        local B = {active = false, second = -1}
        B.root = mk("Frame", {Name = "BoomboxSpotify", Parent = BoomboxPill,

        mk("UIScale", {Scale = 0.75}, B.root)
        B.cover = mk("ImageLabel", {Parent = B.root, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0.5, -16), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35),
            BorderSizePixel = 0, Image = "", ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, ZIndex = 15})
        corner(B.cover, 7)
        B.title = mk("TextLabel", {Parent = B.root, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 3),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -166, 0, 14), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "", TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 15})
        B.artist = mk("TextLabel", {Parent = B.root, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 16),

        B.time = mk("TextLabel", {Parent = B.root, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 28),

            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 16})
        B.fill:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
        corner(B.fill, 2)
        local function button(name, right, image, callback)
            local b = mk("ImageButton", {Name = name, Parent = B.root,
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, right, 0.5, 0),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(27, 27), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Image = asset(image), ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 16})

        end
        B.previous = button("Previous", -91, 124844823753990, previousTrack)
        B.previous.Rotation = 180
        B.play = button("PlayPause", -62, 135609604299893, togglePlayback)
        B.next = button("Next", -33, 124844823753990, nextTrack)
        B.close = mk("TextButton", {Parent = B.root, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 27),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "×", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220),
            Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 20, AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 16})
        B.close.Activated:Connect(function()
            destroyCurrentSound()
            SpotifyState.IsPlaying = false
            SpotifyState.CurrentTrack = nil
            SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition = 0

        end)
        function B.layout()
            if not B.active then return end
            -- AbsoluteSize ya incluye MainScale; convertir a unidades locales evita aplicar la escala dos veces.
            local parentScale = math.max(MainScale.Scale, 0.01)
            local width = math.clamp((TopBar.AbsoluteSize.X / parentScale) * 0.37, 180, 280)
            BoomboxPill.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 30)
            BoomboxPill.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -width / 2, 0, 3)
            BannerFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -width / 2 - 6, 0, 18)
        end
        TopBar:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(B.layout)
        MainScale:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Scale"):Connect(B.layout)
        SpotifyState.RefreshBoombox = function()
            local sound = SpotifyState.CurrentSound
            local active = sound ~= nil and SpotifyState.CurrentTrack ~= nil
            if active ~= B.active then
                B.active = active
                B.root.Visible = active
                Boom.Disc.Visible = not active
                BoomboxInput.Visible = not active
                BoomboxPlaceholder.Visible = not active and BoomboxInput.Text == ""
                BannerFrame.Visible = not (Window._SpotifyAmbient and Window._SpotifyAmbient.Active)
                if active then
                    B.layout()
                else
                    BoomboxPill.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(155, 28)
                    BoomboxPill.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -77, 0.5, -18)
                    BannerFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -83, 0.5, 0)
                end
            end
            if not active then return end
            if B.title.Text ~= PlayerSongTitle.Text then B.title.Text = PlayerSongTitle.Text end
            if B.artist.Text ~= PlayerSongArtist.Text then B.artist.Text = PlayerSongArtist.Text end
            if B.cover.Image ~= AlbumArt.Image then B.cover.Image = AlbumArt.Image end
            B.play.Image = SpotifyState.IsPlaying and asset(74873705394436) or asset(135609604299893)
            local current = math.max(0, tonumber(sound.TimePosition) or 0)
            local duration = tonumber(sound.TimeLength) or 0
            if duration <= 0 then duration = durationToSeconds(SpotifyState.CurrentTrack.Duration) end
            B.time.Text = secondsToClock(current)
            B.total.Text = secondsToClock(duration)
            B.fill.Size = UDim2.new(duration > 0 and math.clamp(current / duration, 0, 1) or 0, 0, 1, 0)
        end
        SpotifyState.RefreshBoombox()
    end
